
=== WebPanel: WWPBaseObjects.Notifications.Common.WWP_VisualizeAllNotifications ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	TableMain.Width = 700
	
	WWPNotificationId.Visible = False
	WWPNotificationLink.Visible = False
	WWPNotificationMetadata.Visible = False
	Grid.Rows = Page.Rows
	Form.Caption = 'Visualize all notifications'
	Do 'PrepareTransaction'
	Do 'LoadGridState'
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	Do 'SaveGridState'
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
	NoNotifications.Visible = True
	Grid.Visible = False

--- Grid.Load (Event) ---
NoNotifications.Visible = False
	Grid.Visible = True
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If (Not WWPNotificationLink.IsEmpty())
		Visualize.Visible = True
	Else
		Visualize.Visible = False
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
	NotificationItemIcon.Caption = Format(!"<i class='%1 %2'></i>", ThemeClass:NotificationFontIcon, WWPNotificationIcon)
	&WWPNotificationCreated = WWPNotificationCreated
	If WWPNotificationIsRead
		MarkAsRead.Caption = !'<i class="fas fa-envelope DiscussionsSendIcon"></i>'
		MarkAsRead.TooltipText = "Mark as unread"
		WWPNotificationTitle.Class = ThemeClass:SimpleCardAttributeTitleLight
	Else
		MarkAsRead.Caption = !'<i class="fas fa-envelope-open DiscussionsSendIcon"></i>'
		MarkAsRead.TooltipText = "Mark as read"
		WWPNotificationTitle.Class = ThemeClass:SimpleCardAttributeTitle
	EndIf

--- 'DoVisualize' (Event) ---
WWP_VisualizeNotification(WWPNotificationId)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DoMarkAsRead' (Event) ---
WWP_ChangeNotificationStatus.SetNotificationReadUnreadById(WWPNotificationId)
	GlobalEvents.Master_RefreshHeader()
	Grid.Refresh()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DoMarkAllAsRead' (Event) ---
WWP_ChangeNotificationStatus.SetAllNotificationsOfLoggedUserRead()
	GlobalEvents.Master_RefreshHeader()
	Grid.Refresh()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DoManageSubscriptions' (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If (&IsAuthorized_ManageSubscriptions)
		WWP_SubscriptionsSettings.Call()
	Else
		msg("WWP_ActionNoLongerAvailable")
		Refresh
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== Procedure: WWPBaseObjects.Notifications.Common.WWP_ChangeNotificationStatus ===

--- Source (Source) ---
Stub SetNotificationReadUnreadById(&WWPNotificationId)
	For Each WWP_Notification
		Where WWPNotificationId = &WWPNotificationId
		If WWPNotificationIsRead
			WWPNotificationIsRead = False
		Else
			WWPNotificationIsRead = True
		Endif
	EndFor
EndStub

Stub SetNotificationReadById(&WWPNotificationId)
	For Each WWP_Notification
		Where WWPNotificationId = &WWPNotificationId
			WWPNotificationIsRead = True
	EndFor
EndStub

Stub SetAllNotificationsOfLoggedUserRead()
	For Each WWP_Notification
		Where WWPUserExtendedId = WWP_GetLoggedUserId()
		WWPNotificationIsRead = true
	EndFor
EndStub


=== SDT: WWPBaseObjects.Notifications.Common.WWP_SDTNotificationMetadata ===

--- SDT Structure (Structure) ---
// SDT Extraction
(Raw representation avoided to prevent serialization errors. Core variables added to DataDictionary.)


=== WebPanel: WWPBaseObjects.Notifications.Common.WWP_VisualizeNotification ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	TableMain.Width = 700
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
	For Each WWP_Notification
		Where WWPNotificationId = &WWPNotificationId
		
		//Security Code
		If WWPUserExtendedId <> WWP_GetLoggedUserId()
			NotAuthorized(&pgmname)
		Endif
		
		WWP_ChangeNotificationStatus.SetNotificationReadById(WWPNotificationId)
		If Not WWPNotificationLink.IsEmpty()
			If Not WWPNotificationMetadata.IsEmpty()
				&WWPNotificationMetadataSDT.FromJson(WWPNotificationMetadata)
				&WebSession.Set(&WWPNotificationMetadataSDT.SessionKey, &WWPNotificationMetadataSDT.SessionValue)
			EndIf
			Link(WWPNotificationLink)
		EndIf
	EndFor

--- 'DoMarkAsRead' (Event) ---
WWP_ChangeNotificationStatus.SetNotificationReadUnreadById(&WWPNotificationId)
	Refresh
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Load (Event) ---
If WWPNotificationIsRead
		MarkAsRead.Caption = !'<i class="fas fa-envelope DiscussionsSendIcon"></i>'
		MarkAsRead.TooltipText = "Mark as unread"
	Else
		MarkAsRead.Caption = !'<i class="fas fa-envelope-open DiscussionsSendIcon"></i>'
		MarkAsRead.TooltipText = "Mark as read"
	EndIf

--- Rules (Rules) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
parm(&WWPNotificationId);
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== WebPanel: WWPBaseObjects.Subscriptions.WWP_SubscriptionsSettings ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Cell_Grid_DWC.Class = !'Invisible WCD_' + upper(Grid.InternalName)
	
	Grid.Rows = 50
	Grid_Empowerer.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	Form.Caption = 'Manage my Subscriptions'
	Do 'LoadGridState'
	GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue = Grid.Rows
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
	For Each WWP_UserExtended
		Where WWPUserExtendedId = WWP_GetLoggedUserId()
		&Sms = WWPUserExtendedSMSNotif
		&Mail = WWPUserExtendedEmaiNotif
		&Desktop = WWPUserExtendedDesktopNotif
		&SD = WWPUserExtendedMobileNotif
	EndFor

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	WWPBaseObjects.LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	Do 'SaveGridState'
	&GridCurrentPage = Grid.CurrentPage
	//&GridPageCount has to be loaded manually
	&GridAppliedFilters = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_GetAppliedFiltersDescription(&Pgmname)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangePage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			Grid.PreviousPage()
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			Grid.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			Grid.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangeRowsPerPage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue
	Grid.FirstPage()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Grid.Load (Event) ---
&GridRecordCount = 0
	&WWPSubscriptionRoleIdCollection = WWP_GetLoggedUserRoles()
	For Each WWP_Entity
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	//this code should be inside the For Each used to load the data
	
	//Sample conditions to be added manually:
	//Where <Attribute> = &NotifShowOnlySubscribedEvents when not &NotifShowOnlySubscribedEvents.IsEmpty()
	
	&DetailWebComponent = !'<i class="fas fa-angle-right ArrowIcon"></i>'
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
		&WWPEntityName = WWPEntityName
		&WWPEntityId = WWPEntityId
		&EntityHasItemsToShow = False
		If (Not &NotifShowOnlySubscribedEvents) AND WWP_HasSubscriptionsToDisplay(&WWPEntityName, WWPBaseObjects.Notifications.WWP_NotificationAppliesTo.AnyRecord)
			&EntityHasItemsToShow = True
		Else
			For Each WWPBaseObjects.Subscriptions.WWP_Subscription
			Where WWPNotificationDefinitionAllowUserSubscription
			Where (WWPUserExtendedId = WWP_GetLoggedUserId() And WWPSubscriptionSubscribed = True) Or WWPSubscriptionRoleId In &WWPSubscriptionRoleIdCollection
				&EntityHasItemsToShow = True
				If Not WWPSubscriptionRoleId.IsEmpty()
					WWP_CheckUserIsNotUnsubscribed(WWPNotificationDefinitionId, 0, &EntityHasItemsToShow)
				EndIf
	
				If &EntityHasItemsToShow
					Exit
				EndIf
			EndFor
		EndIf
		If &EntityHasItemsToShow
			&GridRecordCount += 1
			Load
		EndIf
		
	EndFor
	&GridPageCount = &GridRecordCount/Grid.Rows + iif(Mod(&GridRecordCount, Grid.Rows) > 0, 1, 0)

--- &DetailWebComponent.Click (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid_DWC.Object = WWP_SubscriptionsSettingsWC.Create(&WWPEntityId, &NotifShowOnlySubscribedEvents)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- &Mail.Click (Event) ---
&WWPUserExtended.Load(WWP_GetLoggedUserId())
	&WWPUserExtended.WWPUserExtendedEmaiNotif = &Mail
	&WWPUserExtended.Save()
	If &WWPUserExtended.Success()
		Commit
	EndIf

--- &Sms.Click (Event) ---
&WWPUserExtended.Load(WWP_GetLoggedUserId())
	&WWPUserExtended.WWPUserExtendedSMSNotif = &SMS
	&WWPUserExtended.Save()
	If &WWPUserExtended.Success()
		Commit
	EndIf

--- &SD.Click (Event) ---
&WWPUserExtended.Load(WWP_GetLoggedUserId())
	&WWPUserExtended.WWPUserExtendedMobileNotif = &SD
	&WWPUserExtended.Save()
	If &WWPUserExtended.Success()
		Commit
	EndIf

--- &Desktop.Click (Event) ---
&WWPUserExtended.Load(WWP_GetLoggedUserId())
	&WWPUserExtended.WWPUserExtendedDesktopNotif = &Desktop
	&WWPUserExtended.Save()
	If &WWPUserExtended.Success()
		Commit
	EndIf

--- &NotifShowOnlySubscribedEvents.Click (Event) ---
Grid_DWC.Refresh()

--- Rules (Rules) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== Procedure: WWPBaseObjects.WWP_GetLoggedUserId ===

--- Source (Source) ---
&WWPUserExtendedId = GAMUser.GetId()

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(out:&WWPUserExtendedId);


=== Transaction: WWPBaseObjects.Notifications.Common.WWP_Notification ===

--- Rules (Rules) ---
WWPUserExtendedId.SetNull() If WWPUserExtendedId.IsEmpty() On AfterValidate;
Default(WWPNotificationCreated, ServerNow());


=== Procedure: WWPBaseObjects.Subscriptions.WWP_CheckUserIsNotUnsubscribed ===

--- Source (Source) ---
For Each WWP_Subscription
	Where WWPNotificationDefinitionId = &WWPNotificationDefinitionId
	Where WWPUserExtendedId = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_GetLoggedUserId()
	Where WWPSubscriptionSubscribed = False
	&IncludeNotification = False
	&WWPSubscriptionId = WWPSubscriptionId
	Exit
EndFor

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&WWPNotificationDefinitionId, inout:&WWPSubscriptionId, inout:&IncludeNotification);


=== Transaction: WWPBaseObjects.Subscriptions.WWP_Subscription ===

--- Rules (Rules) ---
WWPUserExtendedId.SetNull() If WWPUserExtendedId.IsEmpty() On AfterValidate;


=== Transaction: WWPBaseObjects.WWP_Entity ===

(sin businessLogic extraído)

=== Procedure: WWPBaseObjects.WWP_GetLoggedUserRoles ===

--- Source (Source) ---
&GAMUser = GAMUser.Get()
&GAMRoleCollection = &GAMUser.GetRoles(&GAMErrorCollection)

&WWPSubscriptionRoleIdCollection.Clear()
For &GAMRole In &GAMRoleCollection
	&WWPSubscriptionRoleIdCollection.Add(&GAMRole.GUID)
EndFor

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(out:&WWPSubscriptionRoleIdCollection);


=== Transaction: WWPBaseObjects.WWP_UserExtended ===

(sin businessLogic extraído)

=== Procedure: WWPBaseObjects.WWP_GetUserEmail ===

--- Source (Source) ---
&GAMUser = GAMRepository.GetUserByGUID(&WWPUserExtendedId, &GAMErrorCollection)
&WWPUserExtendedEmail = &GAMUser.EMail

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&WWPUserExtendedId, out:&WWPUserExtendedEmail);


=== Procedure: WWPBaseObjects.WWP_GetUserFullName ===

--- Source (Source) ---
&GAMUser = GAMRepository.GetUserByGUID(&WWPUserExtendedId, &GAMErrorCollection)
&WWPUserExtendedFullName = iif(&GAMUser.FirstName.IsEmpty(), &GAMUser.Name, &GAMUser.FirstName.Trim() + " " + &GAMUser.LastName.Trim())

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&WWPUserExtendedId, out:&WWPUserExtendedFullName);


=== Procedure: WWPBaseObjects.WWP_GetUserPhone ===

--- Source (Source) ---
&GAMUser = GAMRepository.GetUserByGUID(&WWPUserExtendedId, &GAMErrorCollection)
&WWPUserExtendedPhone = &GAMUser.Phone

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&WWPUserExtendedId, out:&WWPUserExtendedPhone);
